existingFixParts.component: Exhaust manifold with integrated three-way catalyst assembly (2013-2018 L33, QR25DE 2.5L) - Federal emissions

existingFixParts.note: Genuine Nissan 'Manifold Assembly-Exhaust W/Catalyst' for California-emissions 2015-2018 Altima 2.5L (QR25DE). existingFixParts.component: Exhaust manifold with integrated catalyst assembly (California / CARB emissions, 2015-2018 L33)

existingFixParts.note: Genuine Nissan manifold gasket for 2013-2020 Altima and 2012-2020 Rogue 2.5L. Always renew this gasket when the manifold/catalyst assembly is unbolted from the head - reusing the old one is a common cause of a persistent post-repair tick/leak.

existingFixParts.note: OEM 226A0-1KT0A is the genuine Nissan downstream heated O2 sensor used on Rogue/Altima 2.5L; NGK 24056 confirmed as the 2014-2020 Rogue downstream aftermarket unit. existingFixParts.component: Downstream heated oxygen sensor — Sensor 2 (post-cat, monitors efficiency)
